newsitem.title: ITALY: Insurer Generali sees higher ROE in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Insurer Generali sees higher ROE in 1997.

text.p: Italian insurance group Assicurazioni Generali expects to see return on equity (ROE) rising to 10 percent in 1997 from eight percent in 1996, analysts who attended a meeting with Generali management said.
They said Generali said it aimed for further growth in ROE to 14 percent in the year 2000.
Managing Director Gianfranco Gutty also told the analysts' meeting that Generali saw return on investment (ROI) improving to 10 percent this year from around nine percent in 1996.

Analysts who attended the meeting said senior managers at Generali, which has in the past been criticised for its lack of openness over growth and strategy forecasts, pledged that this meeting would be the first of a series of meetings with institutional investors.
Generali wished to give a message of more transparency to shareholders, they added.
